import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

MAIN = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', MAIN)

def q(t):
    return f'{{{MAIN}}}{t}'

src = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
entries = {i.filename: i for i in src.infolist()}

def parse(name):
    return ET.fromstring(src.read(name))

# ---------- sheet1.xml ----------
sheet = parse('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml')
dim = sheet.find(q('dimension'))
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')
cols = sheet.find(q('cols'))
ET.SubElement(cols, q('col'), {'width': '14', 'customWidth': '1', 'min': '8', 'max': '8'})
sheetData = sheet.find(q('sheetData'))
rows = {int(r.get('r')): r for r in sheetData.findall(q('row'))}

# Header H1 (matches existing header style s=1)
hcell = ET.SubElement(rows[1], q('c'), {'r': 'H1', 's': '1', 't': 'inlineStr'})
is_ = ET.SubElement(hcell, q('is'))
t_ = ET.SubElement(is_, q('t'))
t_.text = 'Profit Margin %'

# Data rows 2..9: Profit Margin % = Profit / Revenue  (style s=3 = 0.0% format)
for rn in range(2, 10):
    c = ET.SubElement(rows[rn], q('c'), {'r': f'H{rn}', 's': '3'})
    f = ET.SubElement(c, q('f'))
    f.text = f'G{rn}/E{rn}'

# TOTAL row 10: overall margin (style s=4 = bold + 0.0% format)
c = ET.SubElement(rows[10], q('c'), {'r': 'H10', 's': '4'})
f = ET.SubElement(c, q('f'))
f.text = 'G10/E10'

new_sheet = ET.tostring(sheet, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

# ---------- styles.xml ----------
styles = parse('xl/styles.xml')
numfmts = styles.find(q('numFmts'))
numfmts.set('count', '1')
ET.SubElement(numfmts, q('numFmt'), {'numFmtId': '164', 'formatCode': '0.0%'})
cellxfs = styles.find(q('cellXfs'))
cellxfs.set('count', '5')
ET.SubElement(cellxfs, q('xf'), {'numFmtId': '164', 'fontId': '0', 'fillId': '0', 'borderId': '0', 'pivotButton': '0', 'quotePrefix': '0', 'xfId': '0'})
ET.SubElement(cellxfs, q('xf'), {'numFmtId': '164', 'fontId': '1', 'fillId': '0', 'borderId': '0', 'pivotButton': '0', 'quotePrefix': '0', 'xfId': '0'})

new_styles = ET.tostring(styles, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

# ---------- rewrite archive, preserving all other parts byte-for-byte ----------
with zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx', 'w') as out:
    for name, info in entries.items():
        data = src.read(name)
        if name == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            data = new_sheet
        elif name == 'xl/styles.xml':
            data = new_styles
        zi = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, date_time=info.date_time)
        zi.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        zi.external_attr = info.external_attr
        out.writestr(zi, data)
src.close()
print('done')
